name: Ireland: Part II package and CTIS upload check
applies_to: the Ireland package as a whole (plan-level checklist step)
sources: https://trialagents.com/ctis/ireland/en/part-ii-document-checklist (items 1-13 and 'Submission checks that prevent avoidable RFIs')

items.check: K1 recruitment and informed consent procedure present, on EU template version 2.0, with a section for every population pathway in the plan.
K2: final English version of every recruitment item.

L1: one blank English SIS/ICF set per population in population_sets whose trigger is true, and a separate or clearly distinct version for each optional procedure that changes the information or consent logic; every population or optional procedure has the correct information and consent document.
L2/R2: other participant-facing materials (diaries, questionnaires, cards, interface text, videos, instructions, letters) present as final English versions.
For every Irish site: M1 CV, M2 declaration of interest and N1 on the current NREC-CT Site Suitability Form.
O1 proof of insurance or indemnity present and valid for the planned trial period.
P1 compensation disclosure present (also when nothing is paid).
P2 other financial arrangements present.
R1: current NREC Statement of Compliance regarding Data Protection or a DPIA (not the generic EU GDPR statement).
S1 biological-samples form present.
Fee evidence (HPRA fee application form and proof of payment) in the CTIS Forms section, not in Part II.
HRCDC declaration obtained or clearly planned before the processing that needs it.
Every Irish document and communication is in English.
No participant signatures in uploaded K and L documents; K1, M1, M2, P1 and S1 not signed at submission; N1 and R1 follow the authorisation fields of the current national forms.
Accessible, searchable Word files or original PDFs; no scanned image-only documents.
Irish site names, investigator names and participant numbers match across CTIS and every form (N1, M1, M2, K1).
Insurance dates are valid for the planned trial period, with renewal explained where cover expires earlier; injury wording in participant documents matches O1.
Compensation, travel and third-party reimbursement details match across P1, P2 and the participant documents.
Sample storage, data retention, recipients, transfers and withdrawal wording are consistent across the protocol, SIS and ICF, R1 data statement and S1.
Consent pathways in K1 match the L1 sets in the package.
Each discrepancy found in the final cross-document review is recorded with its owner and resolution, and the uploaded CTIS files are reviewed rather than only the local folder.

Documents adapted from the reference package contain all Irish national additions (minor under 16 and re-consent at 16, legally designated representative hierarchy, Health Research Regulations safeguards, NREC national forms).
items.applies_when: Ireland is not the reference package

items.check: Correct B-S section prefix and CTIS placeholder for each document; fee evidence in the Forms section.
Unique, self-explanatory title of at most 100 characters: <section code>_<document type>_<subtype>_<country>_<language>_<special attribute>, with only the fields that distinguish the document.
Version and date entered in CTIS metadata, not in the title.
Personal names only where disclosure permits (principal investigator in M1/M2).
Clean, tracked-change, redacted or public and split-file variants clearly distinguished.
Uploaded filename base contains none of ( ) / , . ; | [ ] (the period before the extension is fine).
Submitted through CTIS; documents and RFI responses not sent directly to HPRA or the National Office unless an authority asks.
Article 11 workaround: every mandatory Part II placeholder holds the official placeholder PDF titled Part_II_placeholder_document_Article_11_workaround.
items.applies_when: Ireland receives Part I only under Article 11

items.check: For each document, publication status checked against the current Annex I publication tables (revised CTIS transparency rules; ACT EU guidance v2.2, 30 April 2026).
Publishable documents: personal data and CCI identified separately; public version redacts only qualifying material; signatures never disclosed.
No personal data or CCI in public structured fields.
No drafting instruction remains in any document (see content/conventions/template-instructions.md).
Every document approved by the owner in TrialAgents, or the user has explicitly chosen to export unapproved versions.
